Func - VarMan Error handler.vi

Owning Palette: FuncVI Development

Use this VI in FuncVIs to handle errors produced by VarMan VIs.

Details

Click the parameters for more information

 

InstanceRef is the reference to the CalcExpress instance that evaluates a CalcExpress expression.
var name specifies the variable name on which a VarMan VI operated. The VI uses this variable name to format an error message if an error occurred during the operation.
VM error code is a VarMan Engine error code. Wire this terminal to an err code output of a VarMan VI. If VM error code indicates an error, the VI forms a relevant error message and puts the message to the Error Protocol.
error in specifies an error status before this VI executes. The VI runs normally only if error in is FALSE.
dup var name is a flow-through parameter with the same value as var name.
dup VM error code is a flow-through parameter with the same value as VM error code.
error out returns TRUE if either error in is TRUE or the VI detects an error condition. If an error detected, the VI puts an error description to the Error Protocol.

 

Func - VarMan Error handler.vi - details

The VI is intended for use in FuncVIs.
If a VarMan VI indicates that an error occurred while executing, this VI posts the error description to the Error Protocol. The VI performs nothing if both error in and VM error code controls specify the absence of an error.

For details, see the FuncVI Development topic. Also see Example of use.
